themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and nationalist parties across multiple countries are actively organizing congresses, launching aggressive presidential and legislative campaign bids, and celebrating high poll numbers as they position themselves against incumbent governments.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen officially launched her 2027 presidential campaign at the Orléans congress, emphasizing national sovereignty and leading polls.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini was reconfirmed as Lega leader with a focus on federalism and regional issues ahead of upcoming political battles.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox and the PP finalized strategic electoral pacts and candidate lists across numerous provinces to consolidate the right-wing vote.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party surged to a historic 35.3% in a new poll under Sylvi Listhaug, pointing toward potential solo governance.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump and JD Vance ramped up campaign rallies across states like South Carolina, Montana, and Michigan ahead of the midterms.

themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following Lula da Silva's presidential runoff victory in Brazil over the right-wing candidate, conservative commentators, allied leaders, and party figures across international borders have reacted with mixed congratulations, calls for legal challenges, and analyses of the broader regional shift.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro and allied leaders faced defeat in the runoff election, prompting internal debates over whether to concede or contest the results.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei notably withheld direct congratulations to Lula while celebrating other events, maintaining strict ideological separation despite regional integration pressures.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: US right-wing commentary framed Lula's victory as a significant blow to the broader hemispheric nationalist movement and an embarrassment for allied forces.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish right-wing outlets and politicians analyzed the geopolitical fallout of Brazil's election, noting its implications for the global right.

themes.title: US Diplomatic Backing for Viktor Orbán's International Stature
themes.blurb: Reports emerging from Washington indicate that elements of the US administration are actively floating and backing Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán for the position of UN Secretary-General, drawing mixed international reactions and diplomatic maneuvers.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration officials and allied policy circles reportedly advanced discussions to position Orbán for the top United Nations post.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian diplomatic channels and media engaged with the reports while regional neighbors like Ukraine voiced sharp ironic criticism over the proposal.

themes.title: Populist Energy Policies and Rollbacks of Climate Regulations
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are championing cost-of-living relief through energy tax cuts, opposing European Union environmental frameworks like the Emissions Trading System, and pushing to restart traditional hydrocarbon exploration.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposed emergency legislative sessions and tax cuts on heating fuels, coal, and electricity to counter winter heating cost spikes.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen pledged to abrogate strict environmental legislation and restart hydrocarbon exploration as part of her national sovereignty platform.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Meloni and Matteo Salvini called for urgent EU-level interventions to revise emissions trading systems and protect domestic chemical and housing sectors.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK rolled out extensive pro-growth economic counter-proposals challenging current net-zero trajectories and energy levies.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties across various nations are experiencing internal friction, messaging miscues, and public disputes involving leadership authority, foreign alignments, and media communication strategies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Tensions surfaced within the Italian right as Matteo Salvini's leadership stance on military aid to Ukraine sparked internal debate and factional shifts.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei faced internal cabinet discussions and public critiques from political allies regarding his aggressive rhetoric against journalists.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage publicly blamed staff incompetence for half-empty event venues and messaging hiccups during recent economic policy rollouts.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The AfD leadership scrambled to address a major internal e-mail leak while managing ongoing controversies and regional pressure.
